detailed_description: The Multi Ring Chart Generator creates concentric ring charts for layered comparisons in a compact circular layout. It works well when you want to compare several related breakdowns, such as periods, teams, or goal areas, without switching between multiple separate charts. You can enter segment values for each ring, adjust colors, labels, spacing, and titles, then export the preview as PNG or SVG for dashboards, reports, or presentation slides.
usage_steps: Add the labels and values for each ring so every layer represents the comparison you want to show.
Set the chart title and arrange the inner and outer rings in the order that reads most clearly.
Adjust colors, ring thickness, labels, and spacing to keep the circular layout easy to understand.
Review the preview and refine the data if any segments feel too crowded or visually unbalanced.
Export the final multi ring chart as PNG or SVG for sharing or embedding elsewhere.
usage_examples: Compare planned versus actual spend across several departments in one compact chart.
Show how customer mix changes across quarters using a separate ring for each period.
Build a KPI summary card with separate rings for adoption, retention, and revenue targets.

faqs.question: Is the Multi Ring Chart Generator free?
faqs.answer: Yes. It is completely free with no signup, and you can generate and export as many charts as you need.

faqs.question: When should I choose a multi-ring chart over separate pie charts?
faqs.answer: Use it when several related breakdowns — such as periods, teams or goal areas — benefit from a compact side-by-side circular comparison instead of multiple separate charts.

faqs.question: Which export formats are supported?
faqs.answer: You can download the finished chart as a high-resolution PNG image or as scalable vector SVG for print-quality output.

faqs.question: Can I customize the colors of each ring?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tool offers built-in color themes and lets you adjust segment values per ring, with live preview as you edit.

faqs.question: Is my data uploaded anywhere?
faqs.answer: No. Chart rendering and export happen entirely in your browser; your data never leaves your device.
